title: Fix doc and test wording found in the v0.1.0 relays
lead: Doc, comment and test-wording fixes that v0.1.0 reviewers noted as later work. No behavior change. Line numbers are as of tag v0.1.0.
findings_note: S17 later notes (from the S08, S12, S15 and S17 relays)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** code behavior changes (see the companion code cleanup slice); new docs.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Docs should match the code (gate criterion). These mismatches were minor enough to land v0.1.0 with, and are tracked here.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `README.md` (lines 34-36): the acceptance-test sentence overstates C19, because the canvas check is manual and the web half runs under `node --test`.
- `web/test/model.test.js` (line 25): hard-codes 13 frames for both fixture pairs; derive the count as cycles + 1, as the Go side does.
- `internal/tui/model.go` (line 35) and catalog C97: say the live-count clamp applies only to the final value. Also improve the C102 fixture wording.
- `AGENTS.md` (line 83), `docs/spec/isa.md` (line 316): rewrap the long lines.
- `cmd/pit/serve.go`: the serveUsage symlink wording.
- `docs/spec/asm.md`: the bomber listing is tagged `text` and covered only by `TestSpecListing`; bring it under `TestRoundTripSpecExamples` or say why not.
- `internal/acceptance/doc.go`: keep it, or drop it so the package is strictly test-only. This is the implementer's call, recorded per C35.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `model.test.js` fails if a fixture's frame count is not cycles + 1. Today both fixtures happen to give 13.
- If the bomber listing joins the round-trip examples, `TestRoundTripSpecExamples` covers it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: - Make each wording fix above. Update catalog C97 and C102 with `slicer catalog`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `. scripts/env.sh && go test ./... && go vet ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal web)"`
- `node --test web/test/*.test.js`
- `slicer check`

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-doc-cleanups` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
